notes: v0.16.3 optimizes speed, accuracy and usage in Asympta Computer's existing MCP plugin: lazy bounded ByteTailBuffer for long-running CLI sessions, accurate UTF-8/actual-byte/truncation reporting, and opt-in compact/names capability discovery or max_output_bytes for run_command. An isolated 16.8MB x7 synthetic output workload measured median session latency 199.34->63.55ms, CPU sum 1216->153.5ms, process RSS end 381->80MB; host-load variability qualifies latency. Broad discovery payload 86744B full ->22523B compact / 3095B names; CLI 120349B output ->4432B with 4096-byte budget. All default contracts remain unchanged, no platform permissions bypass. See docs/verification/2026-10-10-v0163-speed-accuracy-usage.md.
